"""Independent scheduling-only review of the CWP daily feedback delta."""
import ast
from io import StringIO
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

import pytest

from tools import pre_push_gate as gate


@pytest.mark.parametrize('changes', [None, ['config/another-owner.yaml'], ['src/company_wiki/unseen.py']])
def test_unknown_config_and_code_ranges_run_same_fixed_nodes_once(monkeypatch, changes):
    calls = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, 'changed_paths', lambda *args: changes)
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate.sys, 'stdin', StringIO(''))
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, '_dispatch_gate', lambda cmd, *args: calls.append(cmd) or 0)
    assert gate.main(['--push-checks']) == 0
    assert len(calls) == 1
    targets = [x for x in calls[0] if x.startswith('tests/')]
    assert targets == list(gate.DAILY_PUSH_CASES)
    assert len(targets) == len(set(targets)) == 9
    assert set(targets) <= set(gate.FAST_CONTRACT_CASES)
    assert all('::' in x for x in targets)


def test_daily_failure_preserves_exact_nonzero_and_single_dispatch(monkeypatch, capsys):
    calls = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, 'changed_paths', lambda *args: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate.sys, 'stdin', StringIO(''))
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, '_dispatch_gate', lambda cmd, *args: calls.append(cmd) or 41)
    assert gate.main(['--push-checks']) == 41
    assert len(calls) == 1
    assert 'fast gate GREEN' not in capsys.readouterr().out


def test_proven_docs_range_runs_no_test_process(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, 'changed_paths', lambda *args: ['docs/plans/independent-status.md'])
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate.sys, 'stdin', StringIO(''))
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, '_dispatch_gate', lambda *args: pytest.fail('docs launched runtime'))
    assert gate.main(['--push-checks']) == 0


def test_ci_inventory_and_leaf_timeout_execution_are_identical_to_head(monkeypatch):
    root = Path(gate.__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    prior = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:tools/pre_push_gate.py'], cwd=root, text=True)
    previous_tree = ast.parse(prior)
    current_tree = ast.parse(Path(gate.__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    def inventory(tree):
        env = {}
        for node in tree.body:
            if (isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1
                    and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name)
                    and node.targets[0].id in {'CURRENT_CI_REGRESSION_CASES', 'FAST_CONTRACT_CASES'}):
                values = []
                for item in node.value.elts:
                    values.extend(env[item.value.id] if isinstance(item, ast.Starred) else [item.value])
                env[node.targets[0].id] = values
        return env
    assert inventory(previous_tree) == inventory(current_tree)
    assert len(gate.FAST_CONTRACT_CASES) == 35
    for name in ('_run', '_run_pytest_gate', '_dispatch_gate'):
        old = next(n for n in previous_tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name)
        new = next(n for n in current_tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name)
        assert ast.dump(old) == ast.dump(new)
    calls = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate, '_dispatch_gate', lambda cmd, *args: calls.append(cmd) or 0)
    assert gate.main(['--fast-contracts-only']) == 0
    actual = {x for x in calls[0] if x.startswith('tests/')}
    assert actual == {x for x in gate.FAST_CONTRACT_CASES if not x.startswith('tests/unit/')}
    assert len(actual) == 22
